movies.title: Sardar 2
movies.review:
Karthi was solid, and the action and spy portions kept me interested.
A little messy and stretched out, but still a decent spy-action thriller

movies.title: Irumudi
movies.review:
The performances and emotional core stand out, while the action adds enough momentum to the story.
Though the pacing feels uneven in places, the second half brings some gripping moments.

movies.title: Ram and Leela
movies.review: The chemistry, comedy and the whole quirky vibe worked really well for me.Rom-com with a little fantasy touch simple, colourful and actually pretty enjoyable.

movies.title: Thudakkam
movies.review:
The action, Vismaya’s performance and the whole first-half buildup were the biggest plus for me.
The second half gets a bit too massy, but overall a fun thriller and a solid debut.

movies.title: Modha Rathri
movies.review:
A chaotic wedding night that somehow turns into a genuinely fun ride.
Messy, funny, and surprisingly heartfelt in parts. Not perfect, but definitely had a good time watching this one.

movies.title: 10 Thing i hate about you
movies.review: Charming rom-com about love, high school chaos, and two people who slowly fall for each other despite their differences.

movie-premam.title: Premam
movie-premam.review: Premam only gets better with every rewatch.

movie-13-going-on-30.title: 13 going on 30
movie-13-going-on-30.review: Lighthearted on the surface, but surprisingly meaningful underneath. 13 Going on 30 is the kind of movie that never loses its charm.

movie-meiyazhagan.title: Meiyazhagan
movie-meiyazhagan.review: A movie that makes you smile, reflect, and miss the people who once made life beautiful. One of those rare films that quietly touches your heart.

movie-27-dresses.title: 27 dresses
movie-27-dresses.review: Light, entertaining, and full of feel-good moments. It reminds you that the best love stories begin when you stop living for everyone else.
